title: Rav Acha bar Rav
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was like a student-colleague of Ravina (Rav Ashi’s colleague), as in Kiddushin 13a: Rav Acha bar Rav sent it before Ravina: “In such a case, what?” He sent him, etc. In Chullin 33a he raised a difficulty against Ravina, and in Bava Batra 124b he said to Ravina, “Ameimar came to our place.” With the later Ravina (bar Rav Huna) he was like a colleague, as in Chullin 97b, where Ravina and Rav Acha bar Rav disagree and asked Mar bar Rav Ashi, who said to them, “Father permits.” Hyman considers it impossible to say that this is Ravina, Rav Ashi’s colleague, who died before Rav Ashi, for then they would not have asked Mar bar Rav Ashi; the language also implies that it was after Rav Ashi’s death. In Sanhedrin 76b: a dispute of Ravina and Rav Acha bar Rav, and Rav Mesharshiya his grandson said: “What is the reason of my father’s father, who exempts?” Hyman places this Rav Mesharshiya among the first Savoraim, as explained in his entry. Likewise in Chullin 49a: a dispute of Rav Acha bar Rav [according to Dikdukei Soferim; in the Gemara, Rav Ada bar Natan, which Hyman considers a scribal error] and Mar Zutra son of Rav Mari. “Rav Shmuel son of Rav Abbahu said: Father was one of the heads of the kallah of Rafram, and he said like Rav Acha bar Rav” (Hyman adds that it is known that Rav Shmuel son of Rav Avuha was one of the Savoraim). “Rav Mesharshiya said: The view of my father’s father is more reasonable.”

notes.text: כתברים is read as כחברים and דרפרס as דרפרם, as disclosed in the original note. The two Ravina identifications, Savoraic chronology, grandson inference and Dikdukei Soferim correction are Hyman’s arguments, not fresh identity merges. Preserve the Gemara’s Rav Ada bar Natan alongside his Rav Acha proposal.

The consulted Chullin 97b first reads Rav Acha bar Rav Ashi opposite Ravina, followed by the question to Mar bar Rav Ashi and Father permits. The following paragraph reads Rav Acha bar Rav addressing Ravina. Both forms are preserved as occurrence-specific readings; they do not independently prove Hyman’s two-Ravina chronology, Savoraic placement or the proposed Chullin 49a correction.
